title: 听力挑战 · 学术讲座问答

rounds.speaker: 主讲人
rounds.line: Unlike the previous model, this framework requires no manual adjustment, and it works faster.
rounds.lineCn: 与之前的模型不同,这个框架不需要手动调整,而且运行更快。

grammar.name: 省略与指代识别
grammar.note: Unlike 后省略了 the previous model 的比较结构;it 指代 this framework,理解指代对象是做题关键。

options.text: The new framework runs faster and needs no manual adjustment.
options.feedback: 新框架的优点是无需手动调整且速度更快。

options.text: The new framework is slower but more accurate.
options.feedback: 原文说它运行更快,不是更慢。

options.text: The new framework requires constant manual adjustment.
options.feedback: 原文说无需手动调整,正好相反。

rounds.speaker: 学生
rounds.line: If we apply this method to large data sets, the results will be similar to those we obtained earlier.
rounds.lineCn: 如果我们将这种方法应用于大型数据集,结果会与我们早先得到的相似。

grammar.name: 指代 those + 省略
grammar.note: those 替代 results 以避免重复;we obtained earlier 是省略关系词的定语从句修饰 those。

options.text: Applying the method to large data sets should produce similar results.
options.feedback: 用于大型数据集会得到与之前相似的结果。

options.text: The method only works on small data sets.
options.feedback: 原文讨论的正是应用于大型数据集,并非只适用于小型。

options.text: The earlier results cannot be reproduced at all.
options.feedback: 原文说结果相似,即可重现。

rounds.speaker: 主讲人
rounds.line: Although the theory sounds plausible, its application in practice is more complicated than in theory.
rounds.lineCn: 虽然这个理论听起来合理,但它在实践中的应用比理论上要复杂得多。

grammar.name: 比较结构省略 + it 指代
grammar.note: than in theory 后省略了 it is complicated;its 指代 the theory's,注意区分理论与应用两个层面。

options.text: Applying the theory is harder than it sounds in theory.
options.feedback: 理论合理,但实际应用更复杂。

options.text: The theory is completely wrong in practice.
options.feedback: 原文只是说应用复杂,并未说理论错误。

options.text: The theory is applied exactly as described without difficulty.
options.feedback: 原文明确说实践比理论复杂。

rounds.speaker: 学生
rounds.line: I agree with the speaker, but the evidence mentioned in the lecture does not fully support it.
rounds.lineCn: 我同意主讲人的观点,但讲座中提到的证据并不能完全支持它。

grammar.name: 指代与省略的辨析
grammar.note: it 指代前文的观点/理论;mentioned in the lecture 是过去分词短语作定语,注意抓指代对象。

options.text: The student thinks the lecture evidence is not strong enough.
options.feedback: 学生认为讲座中提到的证据支持不够充分。

options.text: The student completely disagrees with the lecture.
options.feedback: 学生表示同意主讲人,只是证据不足。

options.text: The student thinks more evidence is unnecessary.
options.feedback: 学生指出证据不足,并非认为证据可有可无。
